source_manifest_policy: Selected proof-source hashes, import closure and source-local options are fixed. The one authorized bounded elaboration-budget revision is recorded in SOURCE_REVISIONS.json; freeze_manifest never rewrites proof-source hashes.
dependency_setup: Separately provision the exact pins in DEPENDENCY_PINS.json; replay scripts install nothing and make no network requests. The preserved strict setup helper also accepts wide as its release-root argument.
full_pass_policy: Only all669 fresh source compilations, exact named terminal axiom reports, and final source/export/external-environment checks yield FULL_REPLAY_PASS. Limited and focused runs never yield that status.
input_cache_notice: Dependency source pins and observed cached artifacts are distinct. Compiled dependency caches are observed/bound to a replay; they are not rebuilt by this helper.
prefix_carry_policy: An old accepted prefix may be inherited only through an explicit audited revision transition proving all carried source/import/option records and original fresh object/input receipts unchanged. Earlier whole-tree focused/full receipts do not certify the revised tree.
